title: GTA 6's Leonida is based on Florida. How big is the real one?
lines: Driving across the real Leonida takes over twelve hours.
What if GTA 6's map were as big as the real Florida?
Rockstar based Leonida on Florida: Vice City is its Miami, plus the Keys and the Everglades.
The real Florida covers about sixty-six thousand square miles, counting its water.
It stretches about four hundred and fifty miles from north to south.
Its coastline runs about thirteen hundred and fifty miles, more than any state except Alaska.
The drive from Key West to Pensacola is about eight hundred and thirty miles.
Even with no stops, that's over twelve hours behind the wheel.
